text: {"name":"wlc_update_station_timing","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Computes and stores a station timing residual, and may derive a peer-based half-offset or flag an out-of-range residual.","subsystem":"mac","var_renames":{"v3":"state_index","v4":"indexed_state","v5":"max_peer_residual","v6":"station_entry","v8":"reference_value","v9":"absolute_residual","v11":"peer_residual","v12":"state_entry","v13":"state_flags"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":85,"meaning":"Indexed-state status flags; bits 0x20 and 0x40 gate processing, and bit 0x10 marks an out-of-range residual."},{"offset":86,"meaning":"Entry index or key used to select indexed state and match peer-list entries."},{"offset":87,"meaning":"Selector byte passed to the timing helper."},{"offset":88,"meaning":"Derived half-offset written to the indexed state."},{"offset":92,"meaning":"Reference value used to calculate the residual."},{"offset":96,"meaning":"Signed residual stored for this entry and read from peer-list entries."},{"offset":107,"meaning":"Indexed-state key used to filter peer-list entries."}]}
